_comment: Permission rules merged into ~/.claude/settings.json — USER scope, so they apply to every
session on this box, including the unattended ones nobody is watching. That makes this the
It is deliberately deny-only. An allowlist would have to be maintained forever and would
still miss the tail, and the point of this box is that sessions can work without stopping to
ask. What is denied here is the small set of things a session on THIS box should never do,
because this box holds an SSH key with push access and a signed-in Claude account.
Per-repo policy is a different job: run /seatbelt inside each clone.
Two rules from skills/seatbelt/REFERENCE.md apply here and are easy to get wrong:
- Write(path), Glob(path) and NotebookEdit(path) are accepted and never matched. They
would look protective and do nothing. Use Read(path) and Edit(path).
- An MCP matcher needs a trailing .* — mcp__github matches nothing, mcp__github__.* matches.
